snippet.title: P.T.O. II gameplay (PC Game, 1992)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for P.T.O. II (aka p.t.o.: pacific theater of operations ii), PC game produced by KOEI in 1992 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/pto-ii/1629/
Playing the first turns of this excellent strategy war game featuring the pacific scenario during WW2.
Played through emulated Windows (Win 98/Win XP) virtual machine.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
